Pi: source distinguishes MB and MF value components and competing action alternatives
X: DDM evidence/decision state and fitted source parameters
C: task/model admissibility constraints remain source-specific; fitting stages are L_formal and not cognitive C
Q: derived value conflict modulates value influence and decision caution
decision boundary is a source criterion
T: trial learning succession and within-decision accumulation

L_ctx: Source task/experimental conditions remain explicit and are not retyped into C solely because they are called conditions.
L_claim: Negative, null, approximation, genealogy and epistemic qualifications remain claim-layer assertions rather than added system roles.
L_formal: Algorithmic inference/search/fitting carriers are kept distinct from source-supported cognitive state; formal plumbing cannot create a coordinator.

system_world_experiment.system: MB/MF value representations plus source-defined DDM decision layer
system_world_experiment.world: two-step task states, transitions, rewards and offered actions
system_world_experiment.boundary: task outcomes update values via P_in; choice/RT emitted via P_out; two-stage fitting pipeline is outside modeled cognitive state

source_defined_coordination_or_gating: direct source mapping from MB/MF values and derived conflicts into decision process; no separately persistent arbitration state is required
